preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fi <= n and fi != i and 1 <= si <= 2 for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, 1))
preconditions.description: Each student's best friend index fi must be valid and not equal to the student's own index, and the sex si must be either 1 or 2.

postconditions.description: The number of formed pairs t must equal the length of the pairs list.

postconditions.expression: e == sum(1 for a, b in pairs if students[a-1][1] != students[b-1][1])
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs e must equal the count of pairs where the students have different sexes.

postconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in pairs) and len(set(a for a, b in pairs)) == len(set(b for a, b in pairs))
postconditions.description: Each student must be included in at most one pair, and no student can be paired with themselves.
